lines.text: Jesus tells His disciples to be dressed for service and keep lamps burning, like servants waiting for their master to return from a wedding banquet.
The master finds his servants on watch and waits on them at the table, even if he comes in the second or third watch.
Jesus says a homeowner who knew when the thief was coming would have stopped the break-in, and John asks if the parable is for them.

wrong_details.wrong: John asks if the parable is for them
wrong_details.true: Peter asks if the parable is for them

lines.text: The faithful manager is put in charge of all the master's possessions, but a manager who says his master will come before dawn beats the servants and gets drunk.

wrong_details.wrong: says his master will come before dawn
wrong_details.true: says his master will be a long time in coming

lines.text: The servant who knew his master's will gets many blows, and from everyone given much, much will be required.
